cases.behavior: ordinary SAF imports the fixed encrypted seed into a fresh app-private store after password approval
real platform CredentialManager create completes after provider selection and fresh password approval; independent RP verifies registration
evidence: RP registration record and public-key digest

cases.behavior: real CredentialManager get returns a signature accepted by independent RP with exact challenge, native origin, RP ID, UP, UV and increasing counter
evidence: RP verification event and persisted counter

cases.behavior: ordinary SAF exports a latest confirmed encrypted backup and provider reports write/read-back verification
force-stop ends the provider process; a new process imports the latest confirmed backup into a distinct fresh private store
evidence: SAF import result and fresh-store identity

cases.behavior: real get after fresh-store restore verifies against the original RP public key with a strictly newer counter and backup-state flag
wrong password during import does not activate the staged vault
wrong password for a selected CredentialManager operation does not deliver a credential
locked provider refuses CredentialManager credential delivery
same package signed by the wrong certificate is refused
wrong package signed by the pinned certificate is refused
cancel/back before approval yields no RP-accepted credential
evidence: ordinary task transition without task clearing

cases.behavior: after selecting a backup target, opening a new picker and cancelling makes Write refuse the old target
after staging A, cancelling or failing a new selection makes Import refuse reuse of A
wrong password for export is refused before truncating or writing the selected destination
restoring a stale backup whose counter was already used does not bypass the RP strict counter rule
evidence: stale backup digest and counter history

cases.behavior: settings are compare-restored; only this run's package hashes, reverse mapping and tracked synthetic documents are removed; unknown changes are preserved and reported

report_rules: Keep every case; report expected, executed, passed, failed, blocked and missing separately.
A successful ADB phase, installation, host test or signature-only unit test does not pass a CredentialManager behavior.
Retain initial failures and later candidate attempts; do not pool runtime hashes into one qualification.
Fresh-store restore on this one phone is not physical cross-device migration or generic passkey portability.
Latest-backup recovery is supported only when its counter has not been superseded at the strict RP.
